title: Workspace Studio configuration
description: Documents ~/.config/omarchy/workspace-studio.json, the source of truth for the compositor layer. Purely presentational bar options live in the plugin's inline entry in ~/.config/omarchy/shell.json instead, not here. Config.js normalizes any document to this shape; nothing rejects a file outright.

version.description: Document version. Older documents are migrated forward by Config.migrate().

workspaces.description: The workspaces this config owns, sorted by id. The length IS the workspace count: adding or removing an entry is how the count changes. Ids are stored explicitly rather than implied by position so gaps are allowed.

id.description: Hyprland workspace id. 1-10 map onto SUPER+1..0; 11 and 12 need SUPER+minus / SUPER+equal.

name.description: Tooltip, optional bar label, and hl.workspace_rule.default_name.

icon.description: One or two Nerd Font glyphs. Empty falls back to the workspace number.

iconName.description: The picker's token for the glyph, e.g. nf-md-briefcase. Stored so the picker round-trips and the file stays readable; nothing reads it at runtime.

color.description: Per-workspace tint for the bar button.

persistent.description: hl.workspace_rule.persistent: the workspace exists even when empty.

default.description: hl.workspace_rule.default: this workspace is its monitor's default. At most one per monitor.

layout.description: hl.workspace_rule.layout. Note that ~/.local/state/omarchy/workspace-layouts/<id>.lua, written by `omarchy-hyprland-workspace-layout-toggle`, is loaded after this file and therefore wins.

layoutOpts.description: hl.workspace_rule.layout_opts, e.g. { "orientation": "center" } for the master layout. Ignored unless layout is set.

advanced.description: The remaining verified hl.workspace_rule fields. null means 'do not emit', which is different from 0 or false.

apps.description: The apps that live on this workspace: a window rule that routes them here, and optionally a way to start them.

label.description: Display only; never emitted into Lua except as part of the rule name.

match.description: hl.window_rule.match. Values are regexes matched in full. At least one non-empty key is needed for a window rule to be emitted.

initialClass.description: Emitted as initial_class. Safer than class for apps that rewrite their class at runtime.

mode.description: none emits only the window rule. onCreatedEmpty becomes hl.workspace_rule.on_created_empty, so the app starts the first time you land on the empty workspace - no boot cost and no sleep races. autostart becomes o.launch_on_start / o.exec_on_start, i.e. login-time only.

launcher.description: Key into the top-level launchers table. When set, the command is that launcher's command plus args.

command.description: Raw command, used when no launcher is chosen. Always wrapped in o.launch() (uwsm-app) on the way out.

delaySec.description: autostart only: emits "sleep N && ". Used to stagger web apps behind the browser that owns their profile.

float.description: true emits float, false emits tile, null emits neither.

silent.description: Emits workspace "N silent": the window lands there without pulling focus.

launchers.description: Shared command prefixes, so a browser profile flag is typed once instead of on every web app.

moveMods.description: Modifiers for 'move window to workspace N'.

moveSilentMods.description: Modifiers for 'move window silently to workspace N'.

keysyms.description: Key per workspace position. KEYSYMS ONLY: Hyprland 0.56.2 silently drops "code:NN" bind keycodes, which then match on the modifier mask alone and fire every bind sharing that mask. The generator refuses anything starting with 'code'.

unbindUnused.description: Unbind SUPER+N for the workspaces this config does not define, so Omarchy's stock ten binds do not outlive a deleted workspace.

reloadMode.description: config-only is the default: it rebuilds rules and binds without re-applying monitor config. Runtime rules cannot be removed once registered, so a real apply is always a reload; eval-only is preview and additive changes only.

landOn.description: Workspace to focus after an autostart restore. 0 disables. Only emitted when something actually autostarts.
